hardware.device_name: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super Developer Kit
hardware.notes: Surveyed on-device 2026-08-09. SUPER variant (67 TOPS) -- latency is NOT comparable to the original 40-TOPS Orin Nano; the paper must say "Super". Power mode is reported; power draw and thermals are not measured.

what_this_measures: Full on-device redeployment of the model produced by step 3: convert to TensorRT, run the conversion gate, run the deployment gate, decide. Closes the adaptation half of the perception-to-adaptation loop.

conversion_gate.question: Is the compiled artifact equivalent to the validated model?

deployment_gate.question: Does the new model beat the incumbent on the fixed test set?
deployment_gate.decision_rule: promote iff retrained TRT accuracy > incumbent TRT accuracy
deployment_gate.caveat: The decision rule is a strict accuracy comparison, as the design specifies. Statistical significance is reported separately and is NOT part of the rule -- do not describe the promotion as statistically significant unless p < 0.05.
